summary.text: George Margetas is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 196, which he has represented since June 2026, and is running for a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Margetas was born in York, Pennsylvania.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Dickinson College and a law degree from Thomas M. Colley Law School.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office as an at-large member of the West York Area School District board and his profession as businessman.
Margetas won the May 19, 2026 special general election for District 196 and assumed office on June 9, 2026, succeeding Seth Grove.
